title: Authority lifetime and synchronisation contract
statement: The time authority must be non-copyable, must have an explicit documented lifetime, and must be safe for concurrent read/query use with deterministic results.

source.reference: packet.md (define synchronization and lifetime rules, including whether the authority is non-copyable); interface-bridge.md REF-002; anchors: XVE-SYS-0147, FR-033

applicability: xverse::xcom::validation time authority ownership contract; strict Doxygen required.
verification_intent: Unit and static: non-copyability assertion; concurrent query test; strict Doxygen build for the documented ownership/lifetime/thread-safety contract.
acceptance_criteria: Copy construction and copy assignment of the authority are not available.
The public API documents ownership, lifetime, and thread-safety guarantees.
Concurrent queries from multiple threads return deterministic results with no data race under the applicable sanitizer check.
